name: 菜鸟裹裹
text:
#!name=菜鸟裹裹
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.adkeyword\.get\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.cncommunity\.my\.station\.query\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.guoguo\.nbnetflow\.ads\.(batch\.show\.v2|index)\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.nbopen\.miniapp\.recommend\.cpc\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.nbmensa\.research\.researchservice\.(acquire|event|close)\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.nbpresentation\.(homepage\.merge|tabbar\.marketing)\.get\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.com\.cainiao\.cnactivitycenter/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.com\.cainiao\.cncreditmarket\.hit\.getactivityhit\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.com\.cainiao\.longquan\.place\.getpageresourcecontent\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/guide-acs\.m\.taobao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.guoguo\.nbnetflow\.ads/i then reject(404)

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% cn-acs.m.cainiao.com, amdc.m.taobao.com
